Package chess.gui

package chess.gui
  • Class
    Description
    BoardPanel
    Draws the chessboard and turns mouse clicks into squares.
    ChessFrame
    The main window: the board, the side panel and the menus.
    ChessGuiApp
    Starts the graphical chess game.
    GameController
    Connects the Swing view to the game: the "controller" in Model-View-Controller.
    GameSettings
    The choices made in the New Game dialog.
    NewGameDialog
    Lets the user choose a game type: against the computer (color and difficulty) or two players at one screen.
    PieceGlyphs
    Draws chess pieces with the Unicode chess symbols (U+2654 to U+265F), so no image files are needed.
    PromotionDialog
    Asks which piece a pawn should become, using a standard JOptionPane with one button per choice.
    SidePanel
    The panel beside the board: whose turn it is, status messages, captured pieces, the move list and the main buttons.
    SidePanel.CapturedStrip
    One row of captured pieces, drawn small.
    SidePanel.Tone
    Kinds of status message, each shown in its own color.
